name: Nashville
meta_description: TDSC investigative consulting in matters touching Nashville: our headquarters city, for healthcare diligence, Tennessee litigation support and asset research.
hero_lede: Nashville is TDSC's headquarters and the base from which all of our engagements are scoped and managed. For matters touching Nashville and Middle Tennessee, we combine local familiarity with Tennessee records, courts and licensing rules, supporting counsel, boards and investors in healthcare, music, manufacturing and real estate.
intro: Nashville is the capital of Tennessee and the seat of a consolidated city-county government, the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County. The Nashville Area Chamber of Commerce, citing the Census Bureau, puts Davidson County's population at about 745,900 in 2025, and the HUD market analysis estimates the wider metropolitan area at about 2.11 million at the start of 2024. Healthcare management is the defining industry: HCA Healthcare is headquartered in the city and Vanderbilt University Medical Center is the region's largest employer. Music and entertainment, corporate operations, insurance services, technology and advanced manufacturing, including automotive and electric vehicle production in surrounding counties, complete the picture.

TDSC is headquartered in Nashville, so matters touching the city are handled by the same team that runs our international work, without a separate local office. Organisations commission investigative work connected to Nashville because so many healthcare companies, physician groups and service providers are founded, financed or acquired there; because music, publishing and entertainment deals depend on rights and relationships that are not always documented; and because rapid growth has brought heavy real estate investment through limited liability companies. Acquirers, lenders, insurers and litigators need to know who stands behind a counterparty, what histories it carries and what assets may be available.

matters.title: Healthcare transaction and partner diligence
matters.text: Nashville is the centre of US healthcare management, with hospital operators, physician practice platforms, revenue cycle firms and healthcare-focused investors. We review principals, related entities, litigation, licensing and enforcement history, including federal health programme exclusions and False Claims Act exposure where relevant, before acquisitions, joint ventures or vendor onboarding.

matters.title: Music and entertainment rights disputes
matters.text: Catalogue sales, publishing deals and management relationships in Nashville often involve closely held companies and informal arrangements. We trace ownership of entities holding rights, reconstruct business histories and identify related parties and assets, supporting counsel in royalty, partnership and fraud disputes and buyers testing what they are acquiring.

matters.title: Executive and investor background research
matters.text: Corporate relocations and fast-growing companies bring frequent senior hires and new investors to Nashville. We compile court, regulatory, corporate, bankruptcy and media records across Tennessee and other states, using lawful public sources and obtaining consent where consumer reporting rules require it, so boards decide on a complete record.

matters.title: Real estate and asset research
matters.text: Rapid growth in Davidson and surrounding counties has drawn investors who hold property through limited liability companies. We work from register of deeds, assessor and court records and entity filings to identify likely beneficial owners and connected assets for lenders, creditors and litigators preparing enforcement.

matters.title: Manufacturing and supplier counterparty checks
matters.text: Automotive, battery and other manufacturing investment around Middle Tennessee relies on chains of suppliers, contractors and logistics firms. We examine ownership, litigation, regulatory and reputational records to help clients confirm that a supplier is stable, properly controlled and free of undisclosed related-party interests or past failures.

local_context.title: Courts sitting in Nashville
local_context.text: State civil disputes in Davidson County are heard in the Circuit Court and the Chancery Court, the latter traditionally handling equitable, corporate and many commercial matters. Davidson County Chancery Court has hosted a business court docket for complex commercial cases. Federal cases are heard in the US District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee, which sits in Nashville, and the Tennessee Supreme Court and Court of Appeals also sit in the city. Counsel chooses the forum; we tailor research to its procedures.

local_context.title: Tennessee investigator licensing
local_context.text: Private investigators and private investigation companies in Tennessee are licensed under Tennessee Code Annotated Title 62, Chapter 26, through the Department of Commerce and Insurance. The program, established in 1990, has since July 2021 been housed within the commissioner-run Detection Services Licensing Program, formerly overseen by the Private Investigation and Polygraph Commission. Company licences require a qualifying agent with verifiable investigative experience and an examination; individual licensees undergo TBI and FBI fingerprint checks and complete continuing education. Fieldwork in Tennessee is performed by appropriately licensed investigators.

local_context.title: Polygraph regulation change
local_context.text: The Department of Commerce and Insurance states that the Polygraph Examiners Act, Title 62, Chapter 27, was repealed effective 1 July 2026 under legislation signed by Governor Bill Lee on 21 May 2026, after which Tennessee no longer licenses polygraph examiners. Organisations that relied on state licensing as a quality marker for polygraph services should now assess examiner qualifications directly and take employment-law advice before using polygraph testing.

local_context.title: Records and registries
local_context.text: Tennessee business entities register with the Division of Business and Charitable Organizations of the Secretary of State, based in Nashville, whose public records show registered agents, principal office addresses and annual report information. Property records for the city are kept by the Davidson County Register of Deeds and the Assessor of Property, while neighbouring Williamson, Rutherford, Wilson and Sumner counties keep their own. Court records are held by each county's clerks, and access to filed documents varies.

tdsc_approach: Nashville is TDSC's headquarters, and every TDSC engagement, in Tennessee or abroad, is scoped and managed from here. For Nashville matters we agree the purpose with the client's counsel first, whether a healthcare transaction, a music or entertainment dispute, an executive appointment or judgment enforcement, and limit research to what that purpose requires. Sources include Tennessee Secretary of State filings, Davidson and surrounding county property and court records, Middle District of Tennessee dockets and federal and state regulatory actions. Any fieldwork is carried out by investigators licensed under Tennessee law. Reports separate verified facts from inference and record sources, so counsel can rely on them in Tennessee or federal proceedings.

faqs.q: Is TDSC actually based in Nashville?
faqs.a: Yes. Nashville, Tennessee is TDSC's headquarters and its only office. TDSC is a DBA and subsidiary of Delator Group. The TDSC name dates to 1873, but the present organisation was reintroduced by Delator Group and has not operated continuously since then. International matters are scoped from Nashville and coordinated with licensed local professionals where needed.

faqs.q: Who licenses private investigators in Tennessee?
faqs.a: Private investigators and private investigation companies are licensed under Tennessee Code Annotated Title 62, Chapter 26, through the Tennessee Department of Commerce and Insurance. Since July 2021 the program has sat within the department's commissioner-run Detection Services Licensing Program. Licence holders can be checked through the department's public licence verification tools before any engagement begins.

faqs.q: Can you support healthcare acquisitions run out of Nashville?
faqs.a: Yes. Many healthcare platforms, investors and service companies are based in or financed from Nashville. We research principals and affiliates, litigation, licensing and enforcement history, federal programme exclusions and media coverage, and we look for undisclosed related parties. Scope is agreed with deal counsel, and we do not access patient information or restricted systems.

faqs.q: Which records matter for Nashville property and asset research?
faqs.a: Davidson County's Register of Deeds and Assessor of Property hold the core property records for the city, but much of the metro's growth is in Williamson, Rutherford, Wilson and Sumner counties, each with its own offices. We combine these with Secretary of State entity filings and court judgments to connect owners, companies and assets.

faqs.q: Where are commercial disputes heard in Nashville?
faqs.a: State commercial and corporate disputes are commonly heard in Davidson County Chancery Court or Circuit Court, and federal matters in the US District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee in Nashville. Appeals go to the Tennessee Court of Appeals or the Sixth Circuit. Counsel selects the forum; we shape research and reporting to its evidentiary needs.
